Messages.Author: joseph mcevoy
Messages.Body:
I have a question about the Madness Network and Out Of Turn master
cards...

Here's the situation. My predator has thoughtfully put out the
Madness network and has been been bleeding me regularly for anywhere between
3 and 6 pool per bleed. I finally pull out a Malkavian of my own, and I
have two "Major Boon" cards in my hand. After my prey finishes his turn, I
send in my Malkavian to bleed, and the bleed is successful. Since it
technically is not my turn, can I then throw down the Major boon and absorb
the one bleed.. only to let my prey take the next +5 bleed my predator
throws at me?

Joseph.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:

> Here's the situation. My predator has thoughtfully put out the

>have two "Major Boon" cards in my hand. After my prey finishes his turn, I
>send in my Malkavian to bleed, and the bleed is successful. Since it
>technically is not my turn, can I then throw down the Major boon and absorb
>the one bleed.. only to let my prey take the next +5 bleed my predator
>throws at me?

Of course. Not your turn is Not your turn. 'Though technically, you
send your Malk over after your Prey has finished his Minion Phase, but
before he starts his Transfer Phase. Not after his turn altogether.
